title: 1.4.12 Name the Structure
description: Four described programs. Log which of the three structures each one needs. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Add tax, then print the total
steps.instructions: Read the description. Log which structure it needs, using console.log. Choose from: sequence, selection, repetition.

steps.title: Print 'pass' or 'retake' depending on a score
steps.instructions: Log which structure this one needs.

steps.title: Print every name on a list of thirty
steps.instructions: Log which structure this one needs.

steps.title: Keep asking for a password until it is correct
steps.instructions: This one needs two of the three. Log both names in a single string, selection first: 'selection and repetition'.

requirements.title: Tax then total is sequence
requirements.description: Logs sequence for a program that just runs its lines in order

requirements.title: Pass or retake is selection
requirements.description: Logs selection for a program that chooses between two paths

requirements.title: Thirty names is repetition
requirements.description: Logs repetition for a program that does the same thing many times

requirements.title: The password prompt needs both
requirements.description: Logs a single string naming selection and repetition together — repetition to keep asking, selection to decide whether the password was right
